_llm_instructions: Populate the fields of 'TEAM MEMBER STATUS REPORT' and write the value of each field under 'Generated Value', based on the project context. Context: the project carrying reference PMO-06.02.

f01_Activities_planned_this_reporting_pe.label: Activities planned this reporting period
f01_Activities_planned_this_reporting_pe.guidance: Tasks and work packages scheduled for execution by this member during this period.

f02_Activities_accomplished_this_reporti.label: Activities accomplished this reporting period
f02_Activities_accomplished_this_reporti.guidance: Tasks and work packages successfully finalized by this member during this period.

f03_Activities_planned_but_not_accomplis.label: Activities planned but not accomplished this reporting period
f03_Activities_planned_but_not_accomplis.guidance: Scheduled tasks that were started but not completed or deferred.

f04_Root_cause_of_schedule_variances.label: Root cause of schedule variances
f04_Root_cause_of_schedule_variances.guidance: Underlying reasons for any task delays or workload obstacles.

f05_Funds_planned_to_be_spent_this_repor.label: Funds planned to be spent this reporting period
f05_Funds_planned_to_be_spent_this_repor.guidance: Planned labor hours or direct expenses allocated for the member this period.

f06_Funds_spent_this_reporting_period.label: Funds spent this reporting period
f06_Funds_spent_this_reporting_period.guidance: Actual labor hours or expenses incurred by the member during this period.

f07_Root_cause_of_cost_variances.label: Root cause of cost variances
f07_Root_cause_of_cost_variances.guidance: Reasons for discrepancies between planned and actual resource expenditures.

f08_Quality_variances_identified_this_pe.label: Quality variances identified this period
f08_Quality_variances_identified_this_pe.guidance: Defects, rework, or non-conformance issues encountered in deliverables.

f09_Planned_corrective_or_preventive_act.label: Planned corrective or preventive action
f09_Planned_corrective_or_preventive_act.guidance: Targeted remedial steps to correct quality issues or prevent recurring defects.

f10_Activities_planned_for_next_reportin.label: Activities planned for next reporting period
f10_Activities_planned_for_next_reportin.guidance: Upcoming work assignments and deliverables scheduled for the next interval.

f11_Costs_planned_for_next_reporting_per.label: Costs planned for next reporting period
f11_Costs_planned_for_next_reporting_per.guidance: Estimated hours or expenditures planned for the upcoming reporting period.

f12_New_risks_identified.label: New risks identified
f12_New_risks_identified.guidance: Potential technical, operational, or resource uncertainties identified by the member.

f13_New_issues_identified.label: New issues identified
f13_New_issues_identified.guidance: Immediate roadblocks, blockers, or dependencies requiring team resolution.

f14_Escalations.label: Escalations
f14_Escalations.guidance: Impediments requiring intervention from the Project Manager or Team Lead.

f15_Decisions_made.label: Decisions made
f15_Decisions_made.guidance: Technical or operational choices adopted by the team member during execution.

f16_Lessons_learned_and_knowledge_transf.label: Lessons learned and knowledge transfer
f16_Lessons_learned_and_knowledge_transf.guidance: Practical findings and best practices captured during task execution.

f17_Comments.label: Comments
f17_Comments.guidance: Additional reflections, notes, or contextual feedback from the team member.
